title: Geekvape Digi Max Pod Vape Kit
description: The GeekVape Digi Max Pod Kit is a powerhouse of performance and innovation, designed to deliver exceptional vaping experiences. Featuring a robust 3000mAh built-in battery, this device supports an impressive 80W max output, making it ideal for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles. The Digi Max is equipped with a 1.47” interactive touchscreen that provides intuitive control over settings and modes, while an adjustable RGB flowing light strip adds a customisable aesthetic. With top airflow control and a convenient top-fill design, this pod kit ensures a smooth, leak-free vaping experience and mess-free refills. The kit includes two J Pod Cartridges with integrated coils (0.4ohm and 0.6ohm), optimised for incredible flavour and vapour production with 50/50 freebase and nic salt e-liquids. Compatible with both J and JR cartridges, the Digi Max offers true versatility for vapers who enjoy experimenting with different coil resistances and vaping preferences. Additional features include multi-mode functionality, auto-draw and button activation, and Type-C fast charging for minimal downtime. The Digi Max also includes GeekVape’s innovative A-lock system, providing safety and peace of mind. Available in eight stunning colours, the Digi Max is an exceptional choice for new and experienced vapers alike. Explore our wide range of vape liquids and pick the perfect partner for this kit. We recommend using High VG ( Sub-Ohm) E-liquid with the 0.4ohm DTL pod only and nIc Salts, 50/50 E-liquid with the 0.6ohm MTL pod. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
